chk_swu_leave_range.name: chk_swu_leave_range
chk_swu_leave_range.value: "staff_wechat_users"."leave_start" IS NULL OR "staff_wechat_users"."leave_end" IS NULL OR "staff_wechat_users"."leave_end" > "staff_wechat_users"."leave_start"

uq_sop_first_payment.name: uq_sop_first_payment
uq_sop_first_payment.where: change_type = '首次支付' AND status = '已支付'

chk_sop_amount_sign.name: chk_sop_amount_sign
chk_sop_amount_sign.value:
("sale_order_payments"."change_type" IN ('首次支付','回款','储值卡抵扣') AND "sale_order_payments"."amount" > 0)
          OR ("sale_order_payments"."change_type" = '退款' AND "sale_order_payments"."amount" < 0)

chk_sop_method_txn.name: chk_sop_method_txn
chk_sop_method_txn.value: "sale_order_payments"."payment_method" NOT IN ('微信','支付宝') OR "sale_order_payments"."external_txn_id" IS NOT NULL

uq_sale_orders_client_pending.name: uq_sale_orders_client_pending
uq_sale_orders_client_pending.where: status = '待支付' AND client_user_id IS NOT NULL

uq_sale_orders_phone_pending.name: uq_sale_orders_phone_pending
uq_sale_orders_phone_pending.where: status = '待支付' AND client_user_id IS NULL

uq_appt_sale_item_active.name: uq_appt_sale_item_active
uq_appt_sale_item_active.where: sale_item_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('待确认','已确认')

uq_so_client_active.name: uq_so_client_active
uq_so_client_active.where: status NOT IN ('已完成','已取消')

uq_point_txn_order_user_type.name: uq_point_txn_order_user_type
uq_point_txn_order_user_type.where: ref_order_id IS NOT NULL AND type IN ('消费赠送','消费冲销')
